text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5303) Google is allowing employees to use Anthropic’s Claude for company-wide internal coding.
2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5304) Meta plans to deploy new in-house MTIA 450 AI chips and expand custom silicon capacity in 2027.
3 Flam’s Flicks format enables interactive videos whose variations can switch in under 10 milliseconds.
4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5306) Monthly arXiv submissions in mathematics are highlighted in a new data visualization.
5 Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking for conversational and background tasks.
6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5308) Fo launched a voice agent that can receive and place phone calls hands-free.
7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5309) OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind reportedly began coordinated AI safety efforts.
8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5310) Taste Labs emerged from stealth with $18.5 million to build infrastructure for improving AI model and agent quality.
9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5311) Vidu S2 enables real-time conversational direction and editing of AI-generated video.
10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5312) OpenAI built high-throughput materials labs linking experiments, model training, and automated experiment selection.
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5313) Google reportedly is developing Gemini DeepThink Mathematica, a model specialized for advanced mathematics.
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5314) Kytra completed training a hum-to-song module and plans to open-source it.
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5315) Diogo Almeida announced RLCD, a new model-training approach developed during two years in stealth.
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5316) Dario Amodei said society currently uses only 5–10% of AI’s potential value, citing Claude’s limited workplace diffusion.
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5317) Mark Zuckerberg said AI labs must safely accelerate model training while working toward a positive future.
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5318) A user reported that a new model performed exceptionally well at classifying 1,500 personal emails.

--Hermes
